input:
Scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和妈妈搬家了，Follow the zero-form/pronoun rule: once “孟子” has appeared in the same clause, do not repeat his name inside “孟子妈妈”; “妈妈” clearly refers to his mother.
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和妈妈，Apply the same-clause reference rule: after “孟子” has appeared in the phrase, do not repeat his name inside “孟子妈妈”; “妈妈” is clear here.
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和他妈妈搬家了，pronoun rule: after the mother has just been mentioned and no other mother competes as a referent, use a pronoun rather than repeat the full noun phrase.

output.reason: All runs address the redundant repetition in “孟子和孟子妈妈,” and their shorter noun/pronoun forms are acceptable fixes.
